sample_mapping_evidence: 22 explicit donor-labeled PBMC RNA specimens, one per donor, from mixed thymus/blood aging study. Source years/months and sex retained; paired thymus records are not additional blood specimens. Cardiac-surgery context preserved; no blanket healthy classification.

source_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting and aggregation were made using the Cell Ranger software v3.1.0 or v6.0.2 (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger)

title: peripheral blood sample of donor7
extract_protocol_ch1: Human thymus samples were collected and transferred to RPMI1640 medium supplied with 10% FBS on ice, the tissues were cut into small pieces to release thymocytes. After thymocytes were collected, the remaining tissues were washed with RPMI1640 for 2-3 times and subjected to digestion with pre-warmed RPMI1640 containing 0.1g/mL collagenase and 100ug/mL DNase at 37ºC for 30-40 mins. The cell suspension was passed through 70m cell strainer and combined with thymocytes collected previously. The cells were centrifuged at 500g for 6min and suspended with RPMI1640 medium for cell counting, staining and sorting.  PBMCs were isolated from peripheral blood using Lymphocyte Separation Medium (LTS1077, TBD). Briefly, blood was added into 15mL tube containing equal volume of Lymphocyte Separation Medium gently and centrifuged at 2000 rpm for 20 min at room temperature with brake off. The PBMCs layer located at the interface were collected and washed with PBS plus 5% FBS.  For scRNA-seq, fresh cells isolated from human thymus were sorted as 7-AAD-CD235a-CD45+ and 7-AAD-CD235a-CD45- cells and combined with ratio at 6:4, or sorted as CD34+ cells or EpCAM+ cells. The sorted cells were applied for 10X single cell RNA-sequencing, TCR repertoire sequencing or cellular indexing of transcriptomes and epitopes sequencing.

For 10X single cell RNA-sequencing and 5’-TCR repertoire sequencing, 20,000 live sorted thymic cells or PBMCs were loaded on to each of the Chromium Controller (10X Genomics). Single cell cDNA and unique molecular identifier (UMI) tagged scRNA-Seq libraries and TCR repertoire Seq libraries were prepared using 10X Genomics platform.
data_processing: The demultiplexing, barcoded processing, gene counting and aggregation were made using the Cell Ranger software v3.1.0 or v6.0.2 (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger)
